documents.text: Dear Valued Guest, regarding your upcoming stay, please note that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. We have no specific rules addressing overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary for your arrival. While a swimming area is mentioned in our general brochure, its location, price, and booking access conditions are not stated in this correspondence. Furthermore, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. Please plan accordingly as these details remain undefined at this stage. We look forward to hosting you.

Booking Confirmation: Your reservation for the Alder offer is secured. Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. The booked accommodation features an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. Please note the quoted amount covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment. Regarding cancellations, neither the payment returned nor the method of refund is documented in this primary contract. However, please be advised that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros under our unbooked offer policy. The distractor belongs to a different, unselected Birch offer and does not apply here.

Agent Notes: Current selected terms completely replace the old policy. Before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction, rendering the void old policy for refund (which stated cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros) obsolete. Arrival and registration at 01:30 are available automatically, without any earlier contact or request. A swimming area is mentioned but its location, price and booking access conditions are not stated. Additionally, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. Ensure clients are aware that the old fee structure no longer applies to this booking.

Agent Notes: We have encountered a significant issue where two equally current and authoritative policies disagree. Neither overrides the other, leaving applicable terms unresolved. One policy states that before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money, with no deduction, while the conflicting policy insists that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. Regarding arrival, no rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The accommodation charges booked guests 19 euros to enter its onsite swimming pool, in addition to their holiday price. Finally, neither the activity itinerary nor any statement about a guided walk being included in the amount quoted is supplied. Further clarification from management is required before proceeding.

Agent Notes: The selected stay is 8–15 May. Please note that the other dates policy for refund, which states that before the cancellation cutoff the entire payment is returned as money with no deduction, applies exclusively to December stays and is therefore irrelevant here. The active rule is that cancelling before the cutoff still retains a mandatory administration charge of 27 euros. No rules address overnight registration or whether prior contact is necessary. The booked accommodation has an operational swimming pool on its premises, available during the stay without any separate fee. However, the amount quoted covers accommodation only; taking a hike with a guide requires a separate 38 euro payment.
